description: Calculate business days between two dates for SLAs, invoice due dates, shipping and legal deadlines. Counts working days, skipping weekends and national public holidays by country (ISO code). Price $0.001 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"start":"2026-12-01","end":"2026-12-31","country":"US","business_days":22,"holidays_excluded":1,"inclusive":true}
name: business_days
